page_title: BUR 0-2 CHE | Burnley v Chelsea 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

88' 0 - 2 Goal! Marc Guiu produces a great pass that finds Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot past the goalkeeper and into the back of the net. 0:2.
84' Scott Parker decides to make a substitution. Florentino will be replaced by Josh Laurent (Burnley).
82' The referee is firm and issues Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) a deserved yellow card.
81' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
81' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
78' Referee Peter Bankes has finally had enough of Enzo Maresca and brandishes a yellow card at him!
78' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) takes the corner but it's cleared.

77' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Martin Dubravka shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Chelsea get a corner.
76' The referee signals a substitution. Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is brought on as a substitute for Loum Tchaouna.
76' Enzo Maresca has decided to make a change. Marc Guiu (Chelsea) replaces Joao Pedro.
73' The attendance for today's match is 21499.
73' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) is adjudged offside.
72' Substitution. Zian Flemming is replaced by Armando Broja (Burnley).
72' The game has come to an end for Lesley Ugochukwu. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley).
72' Scott Parker has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lyle Foster (Burnley) replacing Jaidon Anthony.
70' Zian Flemming (Burnley) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joao Pedro (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Peter Bankes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' Kyle Walker (Burnley) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Peter Bankes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Liam Delap departs the field of play to be replaced by Malo Gusto (Chelsea).
64' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sends the corner into the box, but Martin Dubravka intercepts it and averts the threat.
63' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
61' Chelsea seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities. 41:59 – the ratio of ball possession.
59' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
58' Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
55' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
54' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Chelsea.
50' Josh Cullen (Burnley) was too forceful with his tackle and Peter Bankes interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
49' Kyle Walker (Burnley) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
47' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Enzo Maresca decided to make a change. Reece James (Chelsea) is replaced by Benoit Badiashile.
46' Peter Bankes blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Chelsea.
42' Half-chance! Liam Delap (Chelsea) plays a pass into the box, but Martin Dubravka reacts well to snuff out the attack.
41' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
40' The referee blows his whistle after Josh Cullen (Burnley) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.

37' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Pedro Neto (Chelsea) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Jamie Gittens and scores magnificently from close range into the right side of the goal. 0:1.
36' Reece James (Chelsea) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
35' The resulting corner from Reece James (Chelsea) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
35' Reece James (Chelsea) works the corner short.
35' A pass into the penalty area from Pedro Neto (Chelsea) is intercepted by the defence. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
33' Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
31' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Martin Dubravka has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
29' Flag goes up against Liam Delap (Chelsea) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
28' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

26' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Peter Bankes with no other option than to blow for a foul.
25' Total attempts – 5:2. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:0.
22' Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.

20' Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
17' Reece James (Chelsea) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

17' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
15' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) jumps into a tackle and Peter Bankes signals a foul.
14' Liam Delap (Chelsea) forces a pass into the box, but Martin Dubravka is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
11' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
9' Liam Delap (Chelsea) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
7' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
7' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
6' The Burnley players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is able to continue to play.
3' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
